title: Florida County Permit Fee Data
description: Authoritative permit fee + Florida-specific context data, per county. v1.1.

county.description: Slug form of the county name. Lowercase, hyphenated. Must match the filename stem.

display_name.description: Human-readable county name as it appears in articles (e.g., 'Miami-Dade County').

state.description: Two-letter state code. All counties in this dataset are FL.

metro_areas.description: Cities, towns, and CDPs within the county. Used by content templates to match an article's location to a county.

hvhz.description: True if the county is in the High Velocity Hurricane Zone per FBC. Only Miami-Dade and Broward qualify as of FBC 8th Edition (2023).

design_wind_speed_mph.description: Ultimate design wind speeds (mph) per ASCE 7-22 / FBC 8th Edition. Cat II = single-family homes; Cat III = schools/hospitals; Cat IV = essential facilities.

data_source_url.description: Primary source URL for the county fee schedule. Must be publicly accessible.

data_source_document.description: Optional identifier for the specific source document (e.g., 'Implementing Order 4-63 effective 2025-06-30').

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date the source document was last reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD). Should be refreshed at least quarterly OR whenever source URL is re-checked. Stale dates (>180 days) indicate the data should be re-verified before being cited.

schema_version.description: Schema version this file conforms to. Bump when breaking changes are introduced.

permits.description: Per-trade permit fee structures. Keys are trade-action identifiers (e.g., 'roofing_replace'). Counties include only the trades they collect at county level.

operational_fees.description: County-wide operational fees that apply across permits (inspection, overtime, permit extension, etc.). Optional.

double_fee_no_permit_pct.description: Penalty multiplier for work done without permit (e.g., 1.0 = 100% additional, doubling the fee)

surcharges_and_fees.description: Surcharges that apply on top of base permit fees. Decimal fractions (0.075 = 7.5%). State statutory surcharges (DBPR/BCAIF 1.5%, DCA 1.5%) apply countywide and may be listed.

county_surcharge_percentage.description: County-specific surcharge applied to permit fees (e.g., Miami-Dade RER surcharge 7.5%)

dbpr_bcaif_surcharge_percentage.description: Building Code Administrators and Inspectors Fund surcharge, statutory per FS 468.631. Statewide value is 1.5%.

dca_surcharge_percentage.description: Department of Community Affairs surcharge, statutory per FS 553.721. Statewide value is 1.5%.

training_education_percentage.description: Training and continuing education fee, where collected as percentage of permit fee.

public_awareness_percentage.description: Public awareness fee, where collected as percentage of permit fee.

code_admin_fee_per_1000_value_usd.description: Code administration fee per $1,000 of work value (e.g., Miami-Dade $0.60/$1,000).

processing_time.description: Typical permit processing time, in days. Optional — include only when the county publishes an estimate.

labor_cost_premium.description: Estimated labor cost premium for this county vs national average. Always an estimate — never authoritative.

incorporated_city_notes.description: Incorporated cities within the county that maintain their own fee schedules separate from the county. Key = city display name. Special key '_scope_note' (string) documents coverage limitations and is exempt from the per-city object schema.

_scope_note.description: Free-text note about coverage limitations. Underscore-prefixed key bypasses the per-city object schema.

special_requirements.description: County-specific or Florida-wide requirements that affect cost or scope.

fee_usd_per_sqft.description: Per-square-foot rate, e.g. $0.96/sq ft Miami-Dade SFR new construction

fee_usd_per_ton.description: Flat per-ton rate, e.g. $24.17/ton Miami-Dade HVAC

fee_usd_per_amp_unit.description: Rate per amperage unit, e.g. $7.26 per 100 amp Miami-Dade service

amp_unit_size.description: Size of amperage unit (e.g., 100 for 'per 100 amp')

fee_usd_per_kw.description: Per-kilowatt rate, e.g. $4.84/kw Miami-Dade heating equipment

fee_usd_per_1000_value.description: Per $1,000 of estimated value, e.g. $7.03/$1,000 Miami-Dade unusual structures

fee_usd_per_100.description: Per-$100-of-value rate for tiered_by_value (e.g. $2.82/$100 Miami-Dade Tier 1 commercial alterations)

source_section.description: Specific section/subsection of the source document (e.g. 'IO-04-63 Section I.B.3')
